notes.title: UNICLR v1.04 Update (Apr 28th)
notes.notes:
Fixed the following battle balance issues for certain characters:
- Linne
Fixed an issue where using her "Soaring Swallow" will occasionally cause her to leap over the opponent, causing her to whiff.
- Seth
Fixed an issue where using his "Rapid Descent" into "Additional input 1" against a cornered opponent will cause him to end up on the other side.
- Chaos
Fixed an issue where Smart steering will enable him to use Azhi Dahaka's special moves despite being under restriction. 
- Mika
Fixed an issue where "Mika's Cannon" has different knockback properties depending on the side she is on.

Fixed an issue where the game language setting changes to Japanese upon update from UNIST to UNICLR, and visiting the Options menu.
Increased video quality of the opening movie.
Incremented replay data version. As a result, older replays may not playback correctly.

notes.title: UNICLR v1.03b Online stats hotfix (Apr 7th)
notes.notes:
We have applied the following fix as of today:
[list][*] Fixed the online stats data.[/*][/list]

Initially, all of the user's online-related data are supposed to have been reset upon the update to UNICLR. However it was found out that the reset was not carried out as expected, and thus it caused a huge amount of miscalculations. As such, upon this fix, we will have to reset or rewind some of the save data, as follows:
[list][*] RIP score shall be restored as closely as possible back to pre-UNICLR update state (last state of UNIST).[/*]
[*] All matchup scores shall be reset. As a result, the consequtive win score shall also be reset.[/*][/list]

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused.
